description: CTAS validation in live's order - the BODY compiles before either column check (a statement both unnamable and uncompilable reports the body's own refusal, including the positioned invalid-argument-types error), wrong column counts refuse as Invalid column definition list in both list spellings, the legal forms stay legal - plus the full Missing column specification rule for CTAS and CREATE VIEW: unaliased literals/functions/expressions refused before the source runs, while (parenthesized, qualified, quoted-name) column references, aliased expressions, star items, explicit lists, and set operations all name themselves. Converted 1:1 from ddl/CtasCheckOrderTest and CtasMissingColumnSpecificationTest (both now retired).
